name: ANTs antsCorticalThickness.sh
purpose: Performs T1 anatomical brain processing: brain extraction, n-tissue segmentation, cortical thickness, and optional registration to a template.

inputs.statement: Anatomical structural intensity image, typically T1; if multiple are given, later ones are used in segmentation but only the first in prior registration.
inputs.quote: Structural *intensity* image, typically T1.  If more than one

inputs.statement: Brain segmentation template: an anatomical intensity template that is not skull-stripped.
inputs.quote: Anatomical *intensity* template. This template is *not* skull-stripped.

inputs.statement: Brain extraction probability mask in the segmentation template space; a binary mask is acceptable.
inputs.quote: Brain *probability* mask in the segmentation template space. A binary mask

inputs.statement: Tissue probability priors in template space; at least four must exist for CSF, Cortical GM, WM, Subcortical GM.
inputs.quote: At least four priors must exist, corresponding to CSF, Cortical GM, WM, Subcortical GM.

conditions.statement: Image dimension must be 2 or 3; other values cause an error.
If the optional registration template is supplied, the template must be skull-stripped.
The optional extraction registration mask must be a binary metric mask defined in the segmentation template space.
conditions.quote: Binary metric mask defined in the segmentation template space (-e).

conditions.statement: At least four prior images are required; fewer causes the script to exit.
The optional registration template may differ from the segmentation template; output in template space then uses the registration template.
conditions.quote: the segmentation template (used for brain extraction and priors) and registration template (used for final, high-quality registration on brain-extracted images) may be different

steps.statement: Brain extraction is performed with antsBrainExtraction.sh, optionally passing the extraction registration mask.
The extracted brain is masked and given a quick N4 bias correction before registration.
steps.quote: Do a quick N4 on the brain before registration

steps.statement: The template and segmentation priors are registered to the anatomical image and the priors are warped to subject space.
N-tissue segmentation is run with antsAtroposN4.sh in two stages, the second using N4-corrected images with 2 iterations.
steps.quote: We do two stages of antsAtroposN4.

steps.statement: Cortical thickness is estimated with DiReCT via KellyKapowski using gray and white matter posteriors.
Optional registration of the brain-masked N4 image to the registration template produces forward and inverse warps and a log Jacobian.
A quality control stage computes summary measurements and tiled mosaic images.

checks.statement: Required programs and scripts are checked for availability on PATH before processing.
Specified anatomical images are checked for existence.
After completion, expected outputs such as BrainExtractionMask, BrainSegmentation and CorticalThickness are checked for existence.
The registration component of segmentation is checked for its transform files.
checks.quote: The registration component of the segmentation step didn't complete properly.

exceptions.statement: If a command exits with nonzero status, the script exits unless debug mode is enabled.
exceptions.quote: ERROR: command exited with nonzero status $cmdExit

exceptions.statement: In BIDS prior formatting, a missing required SGM label triggers a fallback to templateflow SCGM; if absent, the script exits.
exceptions.quote: Hack for templateflow - try SCGM instead of SGM

exceptions.statement: Prior combinations are only allowed for gray matter or white matter; other labels cause an error exit.
exceptions.quote: We only combine with the gray matter or the white matter.

exceptions.statement: If the cortical thickness output is not produced, the script exits with an error.

outputs.statement: Brain extraction mask in subject space.
outputs.quote: BrainExtractionMask- Brain extraction mask in subject space.

outputs.statement: Segmentation image with one label per tissue class; number of classes is determined by the input priors.
outputs.quote: Segmentation image, one label per tissue class.

outputs.statement: Cortical thickness image in subject space.
outputs.quote: CorticalThickness - Cortical thickness image in subject space.

outputs.statement: Optional forward warps (SubjectToTemplate1Warp, SubjectToTemplate0GenericAffine.mat) and log Jacobian are produced when a registration template is supplied.
outputs.quote: SubjectToTemplate1Warp, SubjectToTemplate0GenericAffine.mat - Transforms to be used when warping images from the subject space to the template space

parameters.statement: Atropos spatial prior probability weight for segmentation; default is 0.25.
parameters.quote: Atropos spatial prior *probability* weight for the segmentation (default = 0.25)

parameters.statement: Number of N4 -> Atropos -> N4 iterations during segmentation; default is 3.
parameters.quote: N4 -> Atropos -> N4 iterations during segmentation (default = 3)

claim.statement: Cortical thickness prior image in template space; if not specified, the prior is set to 10mm throughout the brain.
claim.quote: If not specified, the prior is set to 10mm throughout the brain.
